description: A Flutter widget implementing a map-centric home screen with Google Maps integration, location handling, ride request flow, rider simulation, and UI overlays.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main widget representing the map-based home screen with ride functionalities.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: State class managing map, location, ride flow, and UI overlays for HomeFragment.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches current device location, reverse geocodes it, and initializes map markers.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude into a human-readable address string.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Sets up initial rider markers near the user's location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Constructs the Google Map widget with error handling fallback.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays a placeholder UI when Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles map camera idle event to update user location and address.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Creates the bottom UI panel with location info, destination, and ride button.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Displays a status card during an active ride.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens the location search bottom sheet for destination input.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles destination selection, updates markers, and draws route polyline.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a curved red polyline representing the route between origin and destination.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Creates intermediate points for a curved route polyline.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera to encompass both user and destination points.

methods.name: _showRideBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays the ride booking bottom sheet.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching the user with periodic marker updates.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arrival, prompts user to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the journey progress with marker updates and camera movement.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Completes the ride, resets state, and navigates to celebration screen.
